verdict.rationale: Thoropass documents dedicated HIPAA, GDPR, and PCI DSS offerings on the same platform. HIPAA includes control mappings and templates, GDPR is added through its "multi-framework approach", and PCI DSS includes automation software, ASV scans and pentesting. All frameworks map to a single Unified Controls list, so adding a framework reuses existing work instead of needing a new tool. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of multi-framework use, and GDPR- and PCI-specific control-mapping documentation comparable to the HIPAA and SOC 2 mapping guides.

support.subject: As an operations lead, frameworks beyond SOC 2 and ISO — HIPAA, GDPR, PCI DSS — are supported from the same platform so new customer requirements don't mean a new tool

citations.quote: Thoropass brings HIPAA readiness, evidence collection, and third-party assessment together in one connected experience
Adding GDPR to your compliance program is simple and painless with Thoropass's multi-framework approach
You can have it all, from expert guidance to user-friendly PCI DSS compliance automation software, certified ASV scans, pentesting, and a reliable audit partner.
Our expert team of auditors has mapped our offered frameworks to a single, core control list, giving you a centralized location to view and act on your organization's Action Items.
you don't have to worry about fulfilling requirements that have already been addressed by another framework's controls.
Use this guide to identify a Unified Control by its corresponding HIPAA framework control.
